title: Typography—Sans Serif: Helvetica
slide_intent: Teach designers to establish a readable hierarchy with related weights and test it in continuous text as well as in a specimen alphabet.
strategic_value: NASA can carry the typeface used with its identification into publication headings and body copy.
demonstration: The upper text explains the roles of Helvetica Light and Medium. Large character samples occupy the middle, and two settings below show paragraphs and headings in use.
practical_value: Choose Light text and a Medium heading, then compare the broad and narrow settings to judge measure and emphasis.

content_islands.name: Family guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the title and explanation across the header. Separate it from the character specimens with a rule.

content_islands.name: Weight specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack matching uppercase, lowercase, figures and symbols in Helvetica Light and Medium. Label each setting at right.

content_islands.name: Text in use
content_islands.spec: Place wide and narrow samples below a rule. Caption the sizes and set headings above paragraphs so the weight difference remains visible at reading scale.
